data.cultural_impact: The name Jagarnath is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is revered by millions across India and beyond. It is particularly associated with the deity Lord Jagannath, who is one of the most popular forms of the supreme god Vishnu. Jagannath is the presiding deity of the ancient Pilgrimage town Puri in Odisha, India, and prayer and pilgrimage to the temple of Jagannath are central to the religious and cultural life of many Hindu communities. The annual Rath Yatra (Chariot festival) of Lord Jagannath is a grand spectacle and a significant cultural event in Odisha, which attracts huge crowds from all over the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jagarnath holds deep spiritual significance for Hindus as it reminds us of the ultimate reality that God is the controller and sustainer of the entire universe. It is a reminder that no matter how powerful humans may be, we are ultimately dependent on the divine will of the supreme being. The name Jagarnath also signifies strength, protection, and theProvider of peace and prosperity. For those who seek spiritual growth, it serves as a reminder that we must constantly strive to align ourselves with the divine will and live our lives in tune with the natural order of the universe, while seeking the grace and blessings of the deity Jagarnath.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Jagarnath continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Jagarnath, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Jagarnath meaning "Master of the World" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Jagarnath: The Radiant Lord, who awakens the inner consciousness and illuminates the path towards spiritual growth.

seo.title: Jagarnath - Hindu God of Salvation and Liberation
seo.meta_description: Jagarnath, also known as Lord Jagannath, is a revered deity in Hinduism. This god is believed to offer salvation and liberation to his devotees.
seo.description_paragraph: Jagarnath, also known as Lord Jagannath, is a significant deity in the Hindu religion. Originating from the eastern Indian state of Odisha, Jagarnath is worshipped as the Lord of the Universe and the God of Salvation and Liberation. His name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jagat' (world) and 'Nath' (Lord), and is often referred to as 'Mahaprabhu' (the Great Lord) and 'Pitambara' (Lord of the Universe). The god is believed to offer salvation and liberation to his devotees, and is known for his compassionate nature and the ability to free people from the cycle of birth and death.
